title: OpeningHoursSpecification
description:
A structured value providing information about the opening hours of a place or a certain service inside a place.


The place is __open__ if the [[opens]] property is specified, and __closed__ otherwise.

If the value for the [[closes]] property is less than the value for the [[opens]] property then the hour range is assumed to span over the next day.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

closes.title: Closes
closes.description: The closing hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

dayOfWeek.title: Day Of Week
dayOfWeek.description: The day of the week for which these opening hours are valid.

opens.title: Opens
opens.description: The opening hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

validFrom.title: Valid From
validFrom.description: The date when the item becomes valid.

validThrough.title: Valid Through
validThrough.description: The date after when the item is not valid. For example the end of an offer, salary period, or a period of opening hours.
